data.name: Google Sheets: Get Values
data.description: Get values from a range of cells in a Google Sheets spreadsheet using A1 notation (e.g. A1:E5).
data.instructions:
Get cell values from a range in a Google Sheets spreadsheet.

Retrieve data from a specific range or the entire worksheet.

**Inputs:**
- {spreadsheet_id}: The Google Sheets spreadsheet ID
- {worksheet_id}: The worksheet/tab ID
- {range}: A1 notation range (e.g., "A1:E5") — leave empty for all data (optional)

**Output:** {result} contains the cell values from the specified range.
